_ad_notes_2026-11-09: Ad network quirks learned this run: (1) a post supports only ONE 'primary' ad slot; additional ads must be 'secondary' or the save is rejected with 'No primary ad slot available'. (2) The publication has a cap on accepting NEW opportunities; placing offers by their list_ad_offers id tries to accept a new opportunity and failed with 'can not accept any more opportunities'. Fix: embed already-ACCEPTED opportunities by their opportunity_id from list_ad_opportunities(status=accepted) instead of offer ids. (3) Atlas Salt (opp 5293384c, 300c) was the highest payout but its send_by was 2026-11-09T10:22:20Z, before the 16:00 UTC (08:00 PST) target send, so it was excluded as expiring before send time. Ranked remaining valid accepted opportunities by payout: CBDistillery 225, Conde Nast 225, 1440 Media 206. No sponsorship_agreement_items were waiting. All three slots filled with real ads; no placeholders.
